Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O He whose remembrance is an honor for those who remember
And O He whose thanks is a triumph for those who give thanks
And O He whose obedience is salvation for those who obey
Send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَاشْغَلْ قُلُوبَنَا بِذِكْرِكَ عَنْ كُلِّ ذِكْرٍ
Translation: And occupy our hearts with Your remembrance above all remembrance
And our tongues with Your thanks above all thanks
And our limbs with Your obedience above all obedience

Arabic text: فَإِنْ قَدَّرْتَ لَنَا فَرَاغًا مِنْ شُغْلٍ فَاجْعَلْهُ فَرَاغَ سَلَامَةٍ
Translation: And if You decree for us free time from occupation, make it a time of safety

Arabic text: لَا تُدْرِكُنَا فِيهِ تَبِعَةٌ وَلَا تَلْحَقُنَا فِيهِ سَأْمَةٌ
Translation: In which neither blame reaches us nor weariness overtakes us

Arabic text: حَتَّى يَنْصَرِفَ عَنَّا كُتَّابُ السَّيِّئَاتِ بِصَحِيفَةٍ خَالِيَةٍ مِنْ ذِكْرِ سَيِّئَاتِنَا
Translation: So that the writers of our evil deeds may depart from us with a page empty of any mention of our sins
And the writers of our good deeds may leave us
Delighted with what they have written of our good deeds

Arabic text: وَإِذَا انْقَضَتْ أَيَّامُ حَيَاتِنَا وَتَصَرَّمَتْ مُدَدُ أَعْمَارِنَا
Translation: And when the days of our lives come to an end and the terms of our ages expire

Arabic text: وَاسْتَحْضَرَتْنَا دَعْوَتُكَ الَّتِيْ لَا بُدَّ مِنْهَا وَمِنْ إِجَابَتِهَا
Translation: And Your call, which must be answered, summons us
Then send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْ خِتَامَ مَا تُحْصِيْ عَلَيْنَا كَتَبَةُ أَعْمَالِنَا
Translation: And make the conclusion of what the writers of our deeds count against us

Arabic text: تَوْبَةً مَقْبُولَةً لَا تُوقِفُنَا بَعْدَهَا عَلَى ذَنْبٍ اجْتَرَحْنَاهُ
Translation: An accepted repentance, after which You will not call us to account for any sin we have committed
Nor for any disobedience we have performed

Arabic text: وَلَا تَكْشِفْ عَنَّا سِتْرًا سَتَرْتَهُ عَلَى رُؤُوسِ الْأَشْهَادِ
Translation: And do not remove from us any veil with which You have covered us in the presence of witnesses
On the day when You will test the news of Your servants

Arabic text: إِنَّكَ رَحِيمٌ بِمَنْ دَعَاكَ وَمُسْتَجِيبٌ لِمَنْ نَادَاكَ
Translation: Surely You are merciful to whoever calls upon You and responsive to whoever appeals to You
